## About
Crony Body Works is a heavy duty truck collision repair shop in Miami. We work on Medium Duty Vehicles, trucks and trailers, plus heavy equipment, recreational vehicles, fire trucks, ambulances, fleet vehicles and autos.
Our customers care about turnaround time, cost of repairs, and quality of parts and work performed. We see turnaround and cost as one and the same. The longer your truck is in the body shop, the more money it's costing you. So we take weekend and holiday work by appointment when parts are available.
We handle everything from large fleet accounts to small independents, and we deal with all insurance carriers and appraisers. Rated 4.5 from 27 Google reviews.

## Services
- Maintenance, Repair & Collision: Accident repair and upkeep for trucks, trailers and equipment.
- Body, Chassis, Frame & Unibody: Structural and body work, from frame to panels.
- AC Work: Air conditioning repair.
- Full Glass: Glass repair and replacement.
- Hydraulics - Lift Gates, Wet Line: Lift gate and wet line hydraulic work.
- Welding - Aluminum, Steel & Stainless: Welding on aluminum, steel and stainless.
- Fiberglass and SMC repair: Fiberglass is one of our specialties.
- Front end alignment: Alignment work to go with frame and body repairs.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Vehicles and equipment of any size: trucks, trailers, recreational vehicles, heavy equipment, fire trucks, ambulances, fleet vehicles and autos.

Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We deal with all insurance carriers and appraisers.

Q: How do I set up an estimate?
A: Call the shop, drop by, or schedule an appointment online. A member of our team will call you to confirm.

Q: Do you take credit cards?
A: Yes, all major credit cards are accepted.
